title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Status Rules: Night Credits, Card Anniversary Credits and the Annual Reset
content:
Elite night credits count toward Ashbury Rewards tier qualification within a calendar year. This part of the elite status rules governs how they are posted, reversed and reset.

## Clauses in force

1. **Several rooms.** When one member holds several rooms with overlapping nights at one hotel, only the tier's number of rooms that earn elite night credits per stay earn night credits.
2. **Co-brand card anniversary.** On each anniversary of the card account, the co-brand card linked on that date posts the card's annual night credits: 15 for the Ashbury Rewards card and 25 for the Ashbury Rewards Premier card.
3. **Account status.** Night credits are posted only to a membership whose status is active.
4. **Single posting.** A stay posts night credits at most once.
5. **Annual reset.** On the night credit year start, January 1, every membership's elite night credits are reset to zero by a year-end reset transaction equal to the balance; the reset never changes the tier already held.

## Retired clauses

> **No longer in force.** The clause "A completed stay credited to the membership posts the tier's elite night credit per night stayed for each night between the actual check-in and actual check-out dates when the reservation's plan counts toward elite nights and its booking channel earns under the plan's channel rules; Reward Night Rate stays count" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for the night credits of a stay.

> **No longer in force.** The clause "When the nights credited for a stay exceed the nights stayed, the excess is reversed against that stay's night-credit transaction" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for reversing night credits posted for a stay.

## Card anniversary credits

| Card linked on the anniversary date | Annual night credits posted |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards card | 15 |
| Ashbury Rewards Premier card | 25 |
| No co-brand card linked | None under this clause |

## Illustration (hypothetical account)

A member at Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite holds 38 elite night credits on 31 December. On January 1 a year-end reset transaction of 38 night credits brings the balance to zero, and the member still holds Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite.
